compiler.relationship: bundle_head is the direct child of authorized_commit; it adds compiler authorization-boundary tests. The executable is named and hashed as the authorized_commit artifact. The bundle contains and verifies both commit/tree objects.
compiler.claim: Hashes prove artifact integrity and source ancestry/content; bit-reproducibility of the compiler binary is not claimed.

node.claim: Archive and unpacked executable integrity are verified offline; upstream build reproducibility is not claimed.

package_release_source.archive_recipe: deterministic package roots: elm.json LICENSE README.md src/Schelm src/Elm; tar --sort=name --mtime=@1704067200 --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner -czf
package_release_source.note: The recorded commit/tree is the last package implementation/test commit before provenance and audit documentation. Later commits may change only provenance/tests/docs; the release gate recomputes and prints source/archive hashes from the final tree.
